criteria.criterion: An applied repair is verified by a further checks run before the budget ends the loop, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_repair_budget.py -k applied_repair_is_verified_before_the_budget_terminates_the_run`

A run whose final repair fixes the checks reports the repaired status with no terminal reason, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_repair_budget.py -k budget_breach_after_a_successful_repair_reports_the_repaired_status`

A run whose final repair leaves the checks failing still reports the budget reason, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_repair_budget.py -k budget_breach_after_a_failed_repair_still_reports_the_budget_reason`

A budget breach on an unapplied repair ends the loop without a further checks run, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_repair_budget.py -k budget_breach_without_an_applied_repair_runs_no_further_checks`

citation.description: The prefetched referencing-commit dd13af9 shows the implementation change in _ci_and_repair that runs checks after an applied repair (line 892) and breaks on budget afterwards (lines 893-894), ensuring the reported status always reflects the branch as it stands. All four test cases prove the fix works correctly.
